bistro.label: ARtisan Bistro
bistro.title: ARtisan Bistro
bistro.line: An open-source AR framework in Unity (C#) for running cooking-task studies, reused as the base of later spatial computing projects.
bistro.result: Cut development time across projects by more than 50%
bistro.alt: Three virtual customers order food in the ARtisan Bistro AR restaurant

notif.label: AR notifications
notif.title: Notifications in augmented reality
notif.line: Compared sound, object-anchored, viewport and arrow notifications while people cooked in AR.
notif.alt: A virtual burger being assembled in AR

cues.label: Imperfect AI cues
cues.title: Imperfect AI cues in AR
cues.line: YOLOv5 object detection drove AR cues in a visual search task, to test how unreliable AI changes what people do.
cues.alt: A study participant wearing a headset searches a room of colored blocks

soccer.label: VR soccer
soccer.title: VR soccer for concussion assessment
soccer.line: Immersive VR soccer drills for assessing sports-related concussion in players.
soccer.result: Basis of nearly $70,000 in Innovation Delaware fellowship funding to commercialize it
soccer.alt: A virtual soccer player lines up a shot on goal

load.line: Synchronized gaze tracking and behavioral logs through Lab Streaming Layer during a 33-step VR training simulation.
